57214.synopsis:
The city has fallen. Her family is dead. Her friends were killed right before her eyes.
Veronica ran, but it was futile. The moment she locked eyes with it, her life was turned upside down.
“You’ve already been assimilated.”
The man, who roughly grabbed her by the hair, stared at her with disdain as she struggled.
“Do you want to live?”
“Ugh… hng…”
“Even if you have to crawl through the fires of hell, do you want to live?”
“Let me go…”
“Answer me. If you say you want to die, I will grant you a painless death.”
I don’t want to die. I don’t want to die. I’ve only just been reborn.
“Then ask for my help.”
The man, as if reading her thoughts, muttered in a low voice. His burning gaze pierced straight through her.

At that moment, she had no idea that his holy breath and saliva would save her. That he would become her god in the absence of the one who had vanished.

57726.synopsis:
Lu Gu got a marriage on behalf of his brother and married the fierce hunter in Qingxi Village. No matter how wronged he was, under the coercion of beatings, he was still put on the sedan chair. 
How could the Shen family give up on marrying such a ridiculous thing. After a tumultuous fight, Lu Gu was brought back to the Shen family. He was ready to tremble and seek life. 
Who knew that the days after marriage were far less difficult than he imagined, and he could even fill his stomach without having to be beaten. Shen Xuanqing also bought him chickens and ducklings, and built a fence in the backyard to raise chickens and ducks for him. Lu Gu squatted in the backyard and touched the chickens and ducks. After the panic, he was full of joy. Shen Xuanqing said that these were all his.
For the first time, Shen Xuanqing, who was about to go out was stopped by Lu Gu timidly, holding the corner of his clothes. He saw his little fulang showing a short and shy smile, handing over a small bag of fine flour cakes, saying that it was the food for him who was going into the mountains. 
Shen Xuanqing was nibbling on the cakes expressionlessly in the mountains, but in his heart he was thinking that the little fulang was good and diligent. He looked good when he smiled, but he was too thin.

57982.synopsis:

Kurusu Rurina, a (mid-term) transfer high school girl, doesn’t adjust well to her new class due to her apathetic and withdrawn attitude.

62078.synopsis:
On a distant planet, orcs ruled the planet as rulers.
The demon spirits that parasitize all things, and the short and intelligent goblins, all dedicated their labor to the orcs.

can only be regarded as a “rare animal” and sold to the orc nobles.

The man who was nearly two meters tall squatted carefully in front of Mu Le, stretched out his index finger, and poked her face very lightly.
Mu Le, who somehow turned into an eight-year-old doll, did not dare to move.
“Don’t be afraid, little one.”
The man held a shower head as big as Mu Le’s entire arm in his hand, and no matter how soft his deep voice was, it didn’t look gentle at all.

Half a year after her favorite idol Shoutsuki Karin’s retirement, young but successful voice actress Senguu Suzune still had yet to recover. But one day, a newbie voice actress arrives at her agency—That very Karin-sama! While delighted at this unexpected reunion, Suzune opts to keep a calm head and a comfortable distance between the two. To her shock, however, Karin aggressively approaches Suzune on every possible occasion. Was Suzune simply being used at Karin’s convenience? 64126.synopsis:
I fell into the world of a cyberpunk game that I casually beat the ending half a year ago.

64638.synopsis:
In that city, a peculiar urban legend circulated.
“If one found themselves alone in a room at midnight, a ghost would slip through the window and stealthily enter. Once marked by its blade, there would be no escape, and life would quickly meet its end.”
Only she and her master know that this urban legend hold some truth.
Egret, a girl who was taken in by the assassination guild at a tender age, before she could even comprehend the world around her. She was raised as an instrument of assassination and utilized accordingly. Due to her exceptional aptitude for assassination, she was highly valued, but it also subjected her to rigorous training. Emotionally detached and carefully honed, she grew up to be an elite assassination tool, earning the moniker “Ghost.”
On that day, her routine was the same as always—to carry out her assigned tasks.
However, the job she received was different from the usual. It involved a target with a hidden secret. The mark was the eldest son of a duke—a man possessing military power on par with that of a “hero” within the immensely influential duke family.

This is the story of a girl raised as a mere instrument who crosses paths with a girl created as a mana doll, ultimately embarking on her journey as a human.

64894.synopsis:

65150.synopsis:

I thought I was going to walk the flower path as the youngest member of the tiger family, but it turns out I’m not a tiger but a hamster.

65406.synopsis:
A group of tomb raiders accidentally opened Pandora’s Box and strange energy instantly flooded the entire Earth, causing mutations in plants, animals, and humans. Countless people died and they then turned into living dead…
Xu Song felt that before leaving, he should have checked the almanac. First, he narrowly escaped being silenced by the tomb raiders, and after escaping, he encountered an attack from a “resurrected” ancient corpse. It wasn’t until he unintentionally emitted a small fireball that he felt his luck had barely turned.
Then, Xu Song together with Yue Zheng, who finally managed to escape from the tomb at the top of the mountain, were dumbfounded. What’s with these eggplants taller than children and cucumbers thicker than small trees?!

A journey of two straight men bending each other in the post-apocalyptic world.

65918.synopsis:
For reasons unknown, I found myself transported to the familiar game world I knew.
With a sense of urgency, I decided to leverage the pledge system to rapidly grow stronger and find a way back to my original world.
 After all, I had things awaiting me there—my job, friends, and most importantly, my family.

66430.synopsis:
What must be done to save the world from perishing?

“Why do you look at me like that? If you made me wait, it’s only natural that you’ll receive the appropriate punishment.”

67710.synopsis:
Lin Shuang, is an avid planner and master of time management in the field of science and engineering.
She suddenly finds herself transmigrated to a world of cultivation and becomes an outer disciple, considered slow in cultivation progress and lacking talent by her fellow disciples.
The stern and dignified senior in charge warns her, “If you don’t make progress soon, according to the rules, you’ll be expelled from the sect.”
The genius junior sister, aspiring to be a powerful figure, remarks, “With such weakness, going outside might result in being sacrificed by evil cultivators.”
The inner disciple, who values money and tops the assassin ranking, sneers, “Hmph, wasting resources! Give me those spirit stones!”
The disciples from rival sects all mock and make fun of her.
Lin Shuang smiles and says, “Don’t worry, it’s all part of the plan.”
“Every breakthrough requires burning incense and bathing, wasting time. I plan to hold it in until the Golden Core stage and break through all at once, saving a hundred tomato timers (25 minutes each).”
Everyone: “???”
Turning around, they see her accumulate qi for ten years, erupting a hundredfold, and smashing the Golden Core evil cultivator into a pit.
Everyone: “??!”
Several years later, rumors spread throughout the cultivation world about an abnormal and extraordinary elder who disguises herself as a Qi Condensation female disciple each year.
Acting weak, she becomes the champion in the sect’s competition, overturns the evil cultivator’s base, and takes the Demon King as her dual cultivation partner.
Lin Shuang claims, “I’m innocent; I am only at the Qi Condensation stage.”
She’s simply a diligent cultivator, efficiently managing her time.
Senior Brother: …
Demon King: …
A hundred years later, the Sect Master comes out of seclusion and asks, “Has Lin Shuang made a breakthrough?”
Disciple: No. This time, she plans to wait until the Golden Core stage to ascend. Oh, she plans to do it tonight!
Sect Master: ???
Lin Shuang smiles, “From Qi Condensation to Ascension, I’ve had 1230 breakthroughs, saving at least 6000 steps in total!”
All the antagonists who thought she was weak and kept getting beaten are now crying.
Even the celestial beings who welcome ascenders shed tears, “Finally, the legend has reached our realm.”
Later, a book titled “Lin’s Fastest Cultivation Methods” spread throughout the cultivation world.
It includes minimalistic cultivation steps, mind map-style cultivation, Ebbinghaus memory curve, tomato timers, balancing work and rest, multitasking, and more.
Junior disciples: We give up.
Nine-Tailed Fox Demon Emperor, Fu Yuan, possesses ancient bloodlines and can help others with their breakthroughs. During his childhood, he had his eight tails forcibly severed.
In this life, he hates cultivators the most and only wants to perish together with the enemies who exterminated his clan.
But then, a figure in green clothes appears—
“As long as I haven’t removed you from my tomato timer plan for a day, you won’t be able to die.”
“No one can take you away from me!”
Everyone covets his ancient bone bloodline.
But she draws a blood-stopping charm on his bleeding hand, and the dan furnace dances as if a flower blooms in the endless glacier.

68990.synopsis:
One day, Kabejiri Yuki, a high school student, looks at his smartphone and notices a strange app installed. Intrigued despite his suspicions, Yuki starts the app.

70014.synopsis:
Brief overview: A once upon a time story of a farmer who had been a filially pious fool, who, post rebirth, poured his all effort into making money and doting on his wife and daughters.
Detailed summary: In his last life, Zhang Qing Shi had always believed his negligence to be the cause behind his father’s death and his little sister’s wandering off, never to be found. Out of guilt, he had tried his best to be filial to his mother. In desperation, he had even sold himself to give his family a good life. He had returned one day in finer clothing, only to find his wife and daughters all dead, and the culprits had been his mother and brothers… After being reborn, Zhang Qing Shi decided not to be foolishly filial anymore and to become a better husband and father. Upon his sister’s return, this life was also where he learned of the truth he had prior been oblivious to…

70270.synopsis:
“O coveter of god’s powers, I impart upon you the curse of death!”

On a day when the torment of his curse was particularly intense, a woman appeared in the moonlight. Despite entering through the window, she didn’t have the appearance of an intruder. Calmly, she aimed a dagger and declared:
“If you stay still, I won’t hurt you.”
Gart tilted his head, unthreatened, and observed her pink eyes shimmering even in the darkness. 
“You have beautiful eyes”

“Come any closer, and I’ll kill you.”

73598.synopsis:
As a servant of Izumi Hisako, a ruthless and merciless devilish young lady, I spent my daily life enduring abusive language and violence.
“I love you,” “I love you,” “Marry me,” “Look only at me,” “Don’t be anything but me”
One day, she was transformed into a monster who loves me, calling out whispers of love.
She is Izumi Hisako, a woman who time leaped from the future to the past, and was ruined in the future because she couldn’t have a relationship with me.
This time, she wants to go out with me, become my lover, and get married… I am confused every day by her fierce attacks of love as she reveals all of her true nature.
This is a coming-of-age love story of a young man, Hozuki Akane, who is confused by the approach of Izumi Hisako, who has become a losing heroine in such a future, and whose first priority is to live his school life in peace.
———————-
Unable to be engaged to my childhood friend whom I loved so much for a long time, I died in the middle of my ambition. I should have exposed my fondness for him, I should have honestly told him of my love, such regrets ran through my mind like a running light.

I am the only heroine for Akane. I am the only one who will be his girlfriend. I am the only one who will be his fiancée. This is the pure love story of Izumi Hisako, a.k.a. me, and Hozuki Akane. That’s the real synopsis.

76158.synopsis:

136318.synopsis:
Chu Zhao found a cool, aloof beauty in a pond. To repay the favor, she transformed into a red koi fish and spent her days and nights keeping the beauty company in a water tank, even entering her dreams for intimate encounters.
The beauty, Si Jing , is the Senior Sister of Yunshuijian. By day, she is indifferent and cold, like an unwarmable block of ice. Yet, late at night, she is passionately entangled with Chu Zhao, insatiably longing for her.
Chu Zhao was willing to be put in the water tank by Si Jing, enduring various spells of steaming, frying, and boiling, serving as a live teaching example for the junior disciples. However, even when she turned over with her white belly exposed, the beauty wouldn’t spare her another glance.
With red eyes, she lay on Si Jing’s chest and asked, “What exactly is our relationship?” The beauty didn’t answer, coldly avoiding her gaze.
Later, Chu Zhao learned that Si Jing cultivated the Emotionless Dao. She was a paragon of integrity, unsullied by worldly attachments. If she were to fall in love, her Emotionless Sword Dao would be completely destroyed.
The little fish in the water tank never turned her belly back over again. (She ‘died’ or faked her death.)
Upon returning to the Fish-Dragon Clan territory, Chu Zhao married a prospective partner. He was the Sect Master of Kunlunxu, already capable of reaching the God Transformation realm, with exquisite bone structure and extraordinary immortal grace. Everyone who saw them called them a perfect match.
However, on the wedding day, the dazzlingly talented female cultivator Si Jing suddenly arrived to snatch the bride.
Her usually immaculate sword was dripping with blood, and the woman’s eyes were crimson, no longer possessing their former coolness. “Are you willing… to return to Yunshuijian with me again?”
Chu Zhao, now in human form, withdrew her hand from Si Jing’s grasp, looking somewhat flustered. “I… I don’t recognize you.” She had long ago had her past memories erased, and even her “love threads” removed. Si Jing had always been cool, self-controlled, and solely devoted to her path, seen by all the Xuanmen sects as a peerless Sword Cultivation genius of unimpeachable character.
Yet, after her Emotionless Sword Dao was completely destroyed, she descended into the demonic path, openly crashing the wedding and reducing Kunlunxu to ruins.
No one knew that after Chu Zhao left, Si Jing’s soul was torn in two. One half maintained its clear-headed restraint, and the other was consumed by a paranoid, pathological obsession.
Amidst surging red waves, a bond was sealed. Si Jing tied the little fish with soft silk and cradled her close, tempting her to kiss her lips.
The demonic cultivator, hated and feared by the world, restrained the surging crimson in her eyes, her voice low and gentle, “Zhao Zhao, do you recognize me now?” If Chu Zhao liked the cold and heartless person, she wouldn’t mind playing the part. As long as the little fish remained forever confined to her palm.

149118.synopsis:
Qi Yuan is an impoverished honor student at Weilika Noble Academy.
Adhering to the principles of “don’t participate” and “don’t get involved,” he became even more determined in his philosophy after witnessing many of the academy’s iconic chaotic scenes.
For four years, he remained cautious and vigilant. It wasn’t until graduation day that he finally let his guard down.
But not long after, while at home preparing for job interviews, Qi Yuan was ordered by his younger sister to go out and buy groceries. During the trip, he was struck by a speeding sports car and sent flying ten meters away.
Unwilling to die just like that, Qi Yuan used his final breath to memorize the face of the person who killed him, cursing their ancestors for eighteen generations before finally closing his eyes.
————
Qi Yuan never expected to open his eyes again. Looking at his reflection in the glass, he fell into deep thought.
He realized he had returned to his very first day of enrollment.
He thought he was dreaming, but the pain after pinching himself didn’t feel fake.
Finally resigning himself to fate, he dragged the second-hand suitcase he had scavenged towards the dormitory.
However, that very night, Qi Yuan had a strange dream.
In the dream, he was sitting on a bench by a flowerbed, holding a bottle of water.
Qi Yuan was confused, thinking he had transmigrated again. Just as he stood up to leave, a scorching hand grabbed his wrist.
He frowned and tried to shake it off, but the other person held on tight.
Qi Yuan was just about to ask what the hell the guy wanted, but the words were blocked before they could leave his mouth.
“I’m sorry, Baby, I’m late. Don’t be mad.”
It wasn’t just the words that stopped him—it was the face.
If he remembered correctly, wasn’t this one of the academy’s famous, high-ranking elites?
“Yu Qinghe?”
Qi Yuan frowned in confusion.
“Baby, it’s me.”
The man’s eyes were red, fine strands of hair hung over his sharp brow bone, and his puppy-dog eyes sparkled while looking slightly pitiful.
In Qi Yuan’s memory, this guy had always been arrogant and unruly. But right now… um…
Qi Yuan suspected he must have gone crazy to dream of Yu Qinghe calling him “Baby,” especially since he was a straight man.
He pursed his lips and struggled again. He managed to break free, failing to notice the hurt expression on the other man’s face.
Then, without saying a word, he turned his head and ran.
Why wouldn’t he run? Staring at each other would just be awkward.
But no matter how he ran, the scenario would eventually repeat: standing up from the bench, getting his wrist grabbed, and being called “Baby.”
After experiencing the loop a dozen times, Qi Yuan was completely numb.
With no other choice, he used his incredibly basic acting skills to soothe the man: “En, I’m not mad.”
Unexpectedly, the next second, the man cupped his face and kissed him.
Qi Yuan: “………”
Ahhh! I’m going crazy! I’m dirty! I’ve been tainted!
He felt like he was cracking apart; he wanted to kill the guy right then and there.
Before he could throw a punch, the dreamscape began to dissipate. When Qi Yuan woke up, the sky was already bright.
Lying on his bed, dead inside, Qi Yuan had absolutely no solution. He could only treat this bizarre dream as a side effect of rebirth.
He thought that having such a dream once would be the end of it. But when darkness fell again and he drifted off to sleep, Qi Yuan felt the familiar dreamscape returning, and he felt like dying all over again.
———–
After that, Qi Yuan frequently had strange dreams.
The target in the dreams would change—it wasn’t limited to just one person—but they all claimed to be his boyfriend.
As the dreams became increasingly absurd, Qi Yuan spent his days immersed in shame. He had no idea that as the days passed, the powerful elites of the academy were secretly searching for someone.
He was even less aware that some sharp-eyed individuals had already found him and were trying to find ways to get close.

160638.synopsis:
In the chilly early spring, Gu Xiyan’s sister-in-law from her maternal home arrives seeking shelter, bringing along her two young children. Their faces are weary from the journey, expressions filled with panic and desperation, clearly having reached the end of their rope.
However, Gu Xiyan herself had married into a family of higher status than her own. Now, as a young widow living under the roof of her in-laws, she must always tread carefully and dares not make decisions on her own.
She pleaded with the family’s matriarch, the elderly lady. The old woman smiled kindly, her words gentle and tactful, but their underlying meaning was crystal clear: there was no chance.
Leaving the old lady’s courtyard, Gu Xiyan felt utterly despondent. She couldn’t bear to face the desperate, dim look in her sister-in-law’s eyes and those of the two children.
Just then, she caught sight of a tall, stern figure—the legitimate son of the Duke’s household, Third Master Lu, the current imperial favorite with a brilliant future ahead of him.
Since her marriage into the family, this man had never once looked her directly in the eye, always maintaining a detached, indifferent air.
Yet at this moment, Gu Xiyan tightened her grip on the handkerchief in her hand and thought, perhaps I should give it a try?
　　
……
Later, Lu Chenglian rose from the brocade canopy, tossing out a sentence: “I’ll speak to Mother first tomorrow.”
Upon hearing this, Gu Xiyan, without a care for her disheveled clothing, hurriedly propped herself up: “What?”
Lu Chenglian straightened his lapels in an unhurried manner, his tone flat and unperturbed: “You’ll change your name and identity, start as a concubine, and we’ll figure out what comes next later.”
Huh?
Gu Xiyan was dumbfounded.
Turning back, looking at the confused expression on the woman on the couch, Lu Chenghai suddenly realized something, slowly furrowing his brows. “What do you mean?”
Gu Xiyan stammered, “I, I have to keep watch for Chengyuan…”
Lu Chenglian’s expression froze, then finally he understood.
He stared at her for a long while, then sneered coldly, “Gu Xiyan, you’re guarding loyalty for Lu Chengyuan, all the way to my bed?”
